faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow recruitment is 14th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Post-Doctoral Fellow role?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electrical, Electronics, or related areas, with specific journal or experience requirements.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 72,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Post-Doctoral Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position at IIT Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Online.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for this position is Contractual.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection stages for the Post-Doctoral Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Application Screening and a Selection Test.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link will be available in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from any state apply for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates from any state can apply, but the position is located in Gandhinagar, Gujarat.
